newsitem.title: USA: Dow hovers slightly higher, techs hold firm.
newsitem.headline: Dow hovers slightly higher, techs hold firm.

text.p: Wall Street stocks were steady to higher in mid-afternoon on Monday, with technology and small cap stocks continuing to display the most strength.
The Dow climbed to 7084, up 13 points. The Nasdaq Composite stood at 1320, up 14 points or just over one percent while the Russell 2000 rose six points or 1.7 percent to 360.

"There seems to be a bit of rotation back into the small and mipcap names," said Guy Truicko, portfolio manager at Unity Management. "Now that rates are below seven percent again, some of those names look more attractive."
Breadth stayed positive but by a narrower margin than earlier in the day. Winners outpaced losers by about five-to-three on each of the three major U.S. exchanges.
The benchmark 30-year U.S. Treasury remained under pressure, off 11/32 to yield 6.90 percent.
